    theme: default
    highlight: espresso
params:
  input_vcf_file: ""
  input_db_dir: ""
  input_fasta: ""
  input_protein_normalizer: ""
  template_docx: ""

  input_clinical_variants_tsv: ""
---



Ce rapport affiche les mutations d'un fichier VCF, et les compare à une base de 
donnée de mutations conférants des résistances à des antiviraux.

**Requirements:** Le fichier VCF d'entré doit contenir les champs INFO/DP,INFO/AF,INFO/BCSQ.

**Note:** Le rapport du fichier BAM correspondant au fichier VCF devrait être inspécté avant celui-ci pour s'assurer que les séquences de référence sont entièrement couvertes par le séquencage. En effet, il est possible que des mutations soient manquées dans le VCF en cas de couverture insuffisante de certaines régions.

 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(Rsamtools)

get_vcf_meta <- function(vcf_path, key) {
  # lit uniquement le header
  con <- gzfile(vcf_path, open = "rt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)

  out <- NA_character_
  repeat {
    line <- readLines(con, n = 1)
    if (length(line) == 0) break
    if (!startsWith(line, "##")) break  # fini le header meta
    prefix <- paste0("##", key, "=")
    if (startsWith(line, prefix)) {
      out <- sub(prefix, "", line, fixed = TRUE)
      break
    }
  }
  out
}

hgene_version      <- get_vcf_meta(params$input_vcf_file, "hgene_version")
container_sha256   <- get_vcf_meta(params$input_vcf_file, "hgene_container_sha256")
ref_accession      <- get_vcf_meta(params$input_vcf_file, "hgene_ref_accession")
ref_info_status    <- get_vcf_meta(params$input_vcf_file, "hgene_ref_info_status")


# Parse a BCSQ string and return a data.frame()
parse_BCSQ <- function(BCSQ) {
  tibble(str=as.character(BCSQ)) |>
    mutate(fields=str_split(str,"[|]")) |>
    hoist(fields,dna_change=7,gene=2,strand=5,amino_acid_change=6,consequence=1,transcript=3,biotype=4,.ptype = character()) |>
    select(!str)
}

# UL89 renumbering pos for 2nd exon

ul89_offset_nt <- function(chrom) {
  case_when(
    chrom == "UL89_1-HHV5" ~ 888L,
    TRUE ~ 0L
  )
}

report_gene <- function(chrom, gene) {
  case_when(
    chrom %in% c("UL89_1-HHV5", "UL89_3-HHV5") ~ "UL89-HHV5",
    TRUE ~ gene
  )
}

report_dna_change <- function(chrom, pos, ref, alt, dna_change_raw = NA_character_) {
  pos2 <- pos + ul89_offset_nt(chrom)
  case_when(
    chrom %in% c("UL89_1-HHV5", "UL89_3-HHV5") ~ str_glue("{pos2}{ref}>{alt}"),
    !is.na(dna_change_raw) & dna_change_raw != "" ~ dna_change_raw,
    TRUE ~ str_glue("{pos}{ref}>{alt}")
  )
}

report_aa_change <- function(chrom, aa_change_raw) {
  if (is.na(aa_change_raw) || aa_change_raw == "") return(aa_change_raw)
  if (!(chrom %in% c("UL89_1-HHV5", "UL89_3-HHV5"))) return(aa_change_raw)

  m <- str_match(aa_change_raw, "^(\\d+)([A-Za-z*]+)>(\\d+)([A-Za-z*]+)$")
  if (all(is.na(m))) return(aa_change_raw)

  pos_ref <- as.integer(m[,2])
  aa_ref  <- m[,3]
  pos_alt <- as.integer(m[,4])
  aa_alt  <- m[,5]

  aa_offset <- ul89_offset_nt(chrom) / 3L

  paste0(
    pos_ref + aa_offset,
    aa_ref,
    ">",
    pos_alt + aa_offset,
    aa_alt
  )
}



# Helper function to highlight the cell of a table in the HTML report
highlight_cell_spec <- function(v,msk,bg="red") {
  kableExtra::cell_spec(v,
      background = ifelse(msk,bg,""),
      color = ifelse(msk,"white","black"),
      bold = msk
  )
}

# Helper function to format a table
kable_style <- function(...,escape=FALSE,row.names = FALSE,align = "c") {
  kableExtra::kbl(...,escape = escape,row.names = row.names,align = align) |>
   kableExtra::kable_classic("striped",full_width=FALSE)
  #knitr::kable(...,escape = escape,align = align,row.names = row.names)
}

# read a VCF file into a table
query_vcf <- function(vcf_file) {
  mut <- "bcftools query --format '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT\t%BCSQ\t%DP\t%AF\n' '{vcf_file}'" |>
    str_glue() |>
    pipe() |>
    read.table(
      sep="\t",header=FALSE,quote="",comment="",
      col.names = c("CHROM","POS","REF","ALT","BCSQ","DP","AF"),
      colClasses = c(CHROM="character",POS="numeric",REF="character",ALT="character",BCSQ="character",DP="numeric",AF="numeric")
    ) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(DNA_CHANGE = str_glue("{POS}{REF}>{ALT}"))
}

read_resistance_metadata <- function(db_file) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(db_file)
  if (!("metadata" %in% sheets)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(key = character(), value = character()))
  }

  meta <- readxl::read_xlsx(db_file, sheet = "metadata", col_types = "text")
  names(meta) <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", names(meta)))

  if (all(c("key", "value") %in% names(meta))) {
    meta |>
      dplyr::select(key, value) |>
      mutate(
        key = as.character(key),
        value = as.character(value)
      )
  } else if (ncol(meta) >= 2) {
    meta |>
      dplyr::select(1, 2) |>
      stats::setNames(c("key", "value")) |>
      mutate(
        key = as.character(key),
        value = as.character(value)
      )
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(key = character(), value = character())
  }
}

db_file <- file.path(params$input_db_dir, "resistances.xlsx")
db_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(db_file)
db_data_sheet <- db_sheets[db_sheets != "metadata"][1]
db_meta <- read_resistance_metadata(db_file)
db_name <- (db_meta |>
  filter(key == "db_name") |>
  pull(value))[1]
if (is.null(db_name) || is.na(db_name) || db_name == "") {
  db_name <- basename(normalizePath(params$input_db_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
}

```

|                                   |                                         |
|-----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| Nom de la database de résistance: | ``r db_name``                           |
| Dossier de la database de résistance: | ``r params$input_db_dir``          |
| Numéro d'accession référence:     | ``r ref_accession``                     |
| Version du logiciel:              | ``r hgene_version``                     |
| Numéro d'analyse:               | ``r params$input_analysis_number``      |
| Nom du fichier VCF analysé:       | ``r params$input_vcf_file``             |
| Nom du rapport produit:           | ``r params$output_docx_report``         |
| Empreinte cryptographique (SHA-256) du conteneur : | ``r container_sha256`` |

```{r,message=FALSE}
# Load data
db <- readxl::read_xlsx(db_file, sheet = db_data_sheet)
fa <- FaFile(file.path(params$input_fasta))
mut <- query_vcf(params$input_vcf_file)
coverage <- readr::read_tsv(params$input_coverage_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse BCSQ
mut <- bind_cols(mut, parse_BCSQ(mut$BCSQ)) |>
  mutate(
    gene_report = report_gene(CHROM, gene),
    dna_change_report = report_dna_change(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, dna_change),
    amino_acid_change_report = map2_chr(CHROM, amino_acid_change, report_aa_change)
  ) |>
  arrange(CHROM)

# The database was prepared once with hgene_prepare_resistance_db.py.
# R and Word call the same protein normalizer for detected variants.
cmv <- isTRUE(ref_accession == "FJ527563.1") || any(endsWith(db$CHROM, "-HHV5"), na.rm = TRUE)
if (cmv) {
  normalizer <- params$input_protein_normalizer
  if (!nzchar(normalizer) || !file.exists(normalizer)) {
    stop("CMV matching requires input_protein_normalizer pointing to src/hgene_protein.py")
  }
  normalize_tables <- function(mut, db, meta) {
    files <- setNames(replicate(5, tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")),
                      c("variants", "database", "metadata", "out_variants", "out_database"))
    on.exit(unlink(files), add = TRUE)
    readr::write_tsv(mut, files[["variants"]], na = "")
    readr::write_tsv(db, files[["database"]], na = "")
    readr::write_tsv(meta, files[["metadata"]], na = "")
    digest <- get_vcf_meta(params$input_vcf_file, "hgene_ref_fasta_sha256")
    command <- c(shQuote(normalizer), "--fasta", shQuote(params$input_fasta),
                 "--variants", shQuote(files[["variants"]]),
                 "--database", shQuote(files[["database"]]),
                 "--metadata", shQuote(files[["metadata"]]),
                 "--output-variants", shQuote(files[["out_variants"]]),
                 "--output-database", shQuote(files[["out_database"]]))
    if (!is.na(ref_accession) && nzchar(ref_accession))
      command <- c(command, "--vcf-reference", shQuote(ref_accession))
    if (!is.na(digest) && nzchar(digest))
      command <- c(command, "--vcf-fasta-sha256", shQuote(digest))
    if (system2("python3", command) != 0L) stop("CMV HGVS normalization failed; see the Python error above")
    read_result <- function(path) readr::read_tsv(path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                                                na = character(), show_col_types = FALSE)
    variant_keys <- read_result(files[["out_variants"]])
    database_keys <- read_result(files[["out_database"]])
    if (nrow(variant_keys) != nrow(mut) || nrow(database_keys) != nrow(db))
      stop("HGVS table row count differs from its source")
    list(mut = bind_cols(mut, variant_keys), db = bind_cols(db, database_keys))
  }
  # Excel can contain trailing blank rows. They are not resistance records.
  db <- db |>
    mutate(across(any_of(c("CHROM", "gene", "aa_chg_bcsq", "dna_chg_bcsq", "drug",
                          "mutation_type", "hgvs_p", "hgvs_status", "hgvs_note")), as.character)) |>
    filter(!is.na(aa_chg_bcsq) | !is.na(dna_chg_bcsq) | !is.na(drug))
  normalized <- normalize_tables(mut, db, db_meta)
  # Preserve the existing HTML display; HGVS keys are only used for matching.
  mut <- normalized$mut
  db <- normalized$db
  protein_keys <- db |>
    filter(normalization_status == "OK", !is.na(hgvs_p), hgvs_p != "", hgvs_p != "p.=") |>
    select(normalization_gene, hgvs_p, drug_aa = drug, mutation_type_aa = mutation_type)
  dna_keys <- db |>
    filter(normalization_status %in% c("OK", "PARTIAL"), !is.na(dna_chg_bcsq), dna_chg_bcsq != "") |>
    select(CHROM, dna_chg_bcsq, drug_dna = drug, mutation_type_dna = mutation_type,
           database_dna_status = normalization_status)
  mut <- mut |>
    left_join(protein_keys, by = c("normalization_gene", "hgvs_p"), na_matches = "never") |>
    left_join(dna_keys, by = c("CHROM", "dna_change" = "dna_chg_bcsq"), na_matches = "never") |>
    mutate(
      exact_dna = normalization_status %in% c("OK", "PARTIAL") &
                  (normalization_status == "PARTIAL" | database_dna_status == "PARTIAL"),
      drug = coalesce(drug_aa, if_else(coalesce(exact_dna, FALSE), drug_dna, NA_character_)),
      mutation_type = coalesce(mutation_type_aa, if_else(coalesce(exact_dna, FALSE), mutation_type_dna, NA_character_))
    ) |>
    select(-drug_aa, -mutation_type_aa, -drug_dna, -mutation_type_dna, -database_dna_status, -exact_dna)
} else {
  # Match BCSQ with mutations in resistance DB
  mut <- mut |>
    left_join(
      dplyr::select(db, CHROM, aa_chg_bcsq, drug_aa = drug, mutation_type_aa = mutation_type),
      by = c("CHROM", "amino_acid_change" = "aa_chg_bcsq")
    ) |>
    left_join(
      dplyr::select(db, CHROM, dna_chg_bcsq, drug_dna = drug, mutation_type_dna = mutation_type),
      by = c("CHROM", "dna_change" = "dna_chg_bcsq")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      drug = coalesce(drug_aa, drug_dna),
      mutation_type = coalesce(mutation_type_aa, mutation_type_dna)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(-drug_aa, -mutation_type_aa, -drug_dna, -mutation_type_dna)

  if ("gene" %in% colnames(db) && "aa_change" %in% colnames(db)) {
    mut <- mut |>
      left_join(
        db |> dplyr::select(gene, aa_change, drug_gene = drug, mutation_type_gene = mutation_type),
        by = c("gene_report" = "gene", "amino_acid_change_report" = "aa_change")
      ) |>
      mutate(
        drug = coalesce(drug, drug_gene),
        mutation_type = coalesce(mutation_type, mutation_type_gene)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(-drug_gene, -mutation_type_gene)
  }
}

mut <- mut |>
  mutate(
    drug = case_when(
      is.na(drug) ~ "-",
      drug == "" ~ "-",
      TRUE ~ drug
    ),
    mutation_type = case_when(
      is.na(mutation_type) ~ "",
      TRUE ~ mutation_type
    )
  )

```
# Mutations détéctées

Cette section affiche la liste des mutations detéctées (contenu du fichier VCF),
et la confronte à la database de résistances connues.

```{r}
MUT <- mut |>
  filter(str_starts(BCSQ,"@",negate = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(CHROM,POS)

MUT |>
  dplyr::select(
    CHROM,
    dna_change = dna_change_report,
    gene = gene_report,
    amino_acid_change = amino_acid_change_report,
    consequence,
    drug,
    mutation_type,
    read_depth = DP,
    allele_freq = AF
  ) |>
  mutate(across(c(dna_change,amino_acid_change),~str_trunc(.,width=25))) |>
  mutate(allele_freq = highlight_cell_spec(sprintf("%.1f%%",100*allele_freq),allele_freq<0.5,bg="#2E8B57")) |>
  mutate(consequence = highlight_cell_spec(consequence,consequence!="synonymous")) |>
  kable_style(caption="Liste des mutations identifiées par rapport aux références")
```

Légende:

 - `CHROM`: Nom de la séquence de référence
 - `dna_change`: Position de la mutation sur le génome.
 - `gene`: Nom du gène impacté par la mutation.
 - `amino_acid_change`: Position de la mutation sur la protéine.
 - `consequence`: Classification de la mutation (synonymous, missense, stop_gained, frameshift, inframe_shift).
 - `drug`: Nom de l'antiviral pour lequel la mutation confére une résitance.
 - `read_depth`: Profondeur de sequencage au niveau de la mutation.
 - `allele_freq`: Proportion des reads portant la mutation.

# Mutations protéiques

Cette section conserve le détail des mutations modifiant la protéine, y compris
celles sans association à un antiviral dans la base.

```{r protein-mutations, results='asis'}
protein_mutations <- mut |>
  filter(
    str_starts(BCSQ, "@", negate = TRUE),
    consequence != "synonymous",
    (!is.na(amino_acid_change_report) & nzchar(amino_acid_change_report)) |
      str_detect(consequence, "frameshift|inframe|stop_gained|stop_lost|start_lost")
  ) |>
  distinct(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, gene_report, dna_change_report,
           amino_acid_change_report, consequence, DP, AF) |>
  arrange(gene_report, POS) |>
  transmute(
    Gène = gene_report,
    Mutation = coalesce(na_if(amino_acid_change_report, ""), dna_change_report),
    Conséquence = consequence,
    Profondeur = DP,
    `Fréquence allélique` = if_else(is.na(AF), "—", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * AF))
  )

if (nrow(protein_mutations) == 0) {
  cat("Aucune mutation protéique détectée.\n\n")
} else {
  print(kable_style(protein_mutations, escape = TRUE,
                    caption = "Mutations protéiques détectées, par gène"))
}
```

# Mutations retenues pour le rapport clinique

Cette section présente, par gène, les mutations associées à au moins un antiviral
dans la base et tous les frameshifts.

Une association dans la base ne signifie pas nécessairement une résistance.

Les frameshifts sans correspondance dans la base sont affichés sans attribution
d'un phénotype de résistance. 
L'interprétation par antiviral et les limites liées à la couverture figurent dans 
le rapport clinique Word.

```{r clinical-mutations, results='asis'}
clinical_path <- params$input_clinical_variants_tsv
if (is.null(clinical_path) || !nzchar(clinical_path) || !file.exists(clinical_path)) {
  stop("Missing clinical variants TSV: generate it with hgene_clinical_report.py --clinical-variants-tsv before rendering the HTML")
}
clinical_mutations <- readr::read_tsv(
  clinical_path,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character(), pos = col_double(), allele_freq = col_double()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
required_columns <- c("gene", "chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "dna_change",
                      "mutation", "consequence", "allele_freq")
if (!all(required_columns %in% names(clinical_mutations)) ||
    nrow(readr::problems(clinical_mutations)) > 0) {
  stop("Invalid clinical variants TSV")
}
clinical_mutations <- clinical_mutations |>
  arrange(gene, chrom, pos, ref, alt)

if (nrow(clinical_mutations) == 0) {
  cat("Aucune mutation associée à un antiviral ni aucun frameshift détecté.\n\n")
} else {
  for (current_gene in unique(clinical_mutations$gene)) {
    cat("\n\n## ", htmltools::htmlEscape(current_gene), "\n\n", sep = "")
    gene_mutations <- clinical_mutations |>
      filter(gene == current_gene) |>
      transmute(
        Mutation = mutation,
        Conséquence = consequence,
        `Fréquence allélique` = if_else(is.na(allele_freq), "—",
                                       sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * allele_freq))
      )
    print(kable_style(gene_mutations, escape = TRUE))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
